record.one_liner: Gorgias is a helpdesk for ecommerce merchants that centralizes support tickets from email, chat, social and voice alongside Shopify/store order data, with automation and AI agents.
record.auth_notes: Developer docs list two methods: private apps use an API key (account email as username plus API key; HTTP Basic is my inference, since the page doesn't use the term), and public apps must use OAuth2. An OAuth2 Scopes page and an OAuth2 tutorial exist, but I did not open them. The vendor MCP server uses browser OAuth.
record.access_notes: Third-party sources (not vendor pages I fetched) report a 7-day free trial with no card, and no free plan. After the trial a paid helpdesk plan is needed. I could not confirm from a vendor page whether the API is available on every tier or only on higher ones. Building a public OAuth2 app may need extra steps, which I did not verify. A rate limit of about 2 requests/sec is reported, from search results only.
record.blocker: No free tier. Credentials come from a 7-day trial and then a paid plan. Rate limits are low (about 2 requests/sec, unverified). The plan tier needed for API access is unconfirmed. Public multi-tenant apps must use OAuth2. The official MCP server is labeled open beta by Gorgias's changelog.

evidence.auth: https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/authentication — lists Private app: API key; Public app: OAuth2 (required for public apps).
evidence.access: No vendor page fetched confirms trial or tier terms. The 7-day trial and pricing come from third-party search results only. Vendor MCP help page says all Helpdesk plans are supported: https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-gorgias-6310546
evidence.api: https://developers.gorgias.com/llms.txt — index lists 23 REST resource groups (Tickets, Customers, Macros, Rules, Tags, Teams, Users, Views, Voice Calls, Statistics and others). https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/introduction — describes a REST API with JSON.
evidence.mcp: https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-gorgias-6310546 — official help article gives server URL https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp, browser authorization, and the assistant acting with the user's role permissions. The open-beta status comes from a search result for updates.gorgias.com, which I did not fetch.
